summary: Sky Harbour Group Corp filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a registered direct offering of 1,000,000 Class A common shares to M-COR Capital LLC at $10.00 per share, raising $10.0 million in gross proceeds. The offering was made under an existing Form S-3 shelf and closed on August 26, 2026. Net proceeds are for general corporate purposes. Morrison Foerster LLP provided the legal opinion. This is a routine equity capital raise under a shelf registration, not a special-situation event such as a tender, restructuring, or strategic review; there are no unusual structural features or event-driven angles to monitor.
